 * You are the senior technology expert for Software Development, driving innovation, and making strategic technical decisions, that ensure the success of our research and industry projects.

 * Completed technical studies (at least MSc.) in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Embedded Systems, or a related field
 * At least 5 years of relevant industrial software development experience, with a high level of commitment and proven ability to work in a team, preferably a similar field
 * Strong communication skills, with the ability to collaborate efficiently with clients and project managers, and to guide a development team
 * Strong skills in modern C++ and Python, with solid experience in Git, CMake and Linux environments. Experience with Qt/PySide, C#/.NET, MATLAB, CUDA or HPC is beneficial.
 * Experience with software architecture, automated testing, CI/CD, Docker, documentation and secure development practices.
 * Experience with AI-assisted development and coding agents for implementation, refactoring, testing, documentation and code review. Ability to critically validate AI-generated code for correctness, security, performance and maintainability.
 * Knowledge of sensing and camera technology as well as factory automation of advantage
 * Good command of English and German (both required)

What to expect:
 * The minimum gross annual salary on a full-time basis (38,5 h / week) according to the collective agreement is EUR 68.152,--. The actual salary will be determined individually, based on your qualifications and experience.
 * Highlights of our employee benefits include a canteen and meal allowance, organic coffee, tea and fruit baskets, preventive healthcare benefits and company doctor, pension fund, additional days off for various life events, family benefits (including two weeks of paid paternity leave "Papa-Weeks" and leisure subsidies), voucher programme, sports, cultural and socialising events and many more, as well as flexitime models (incl. up to 50% home office), travel support for conferences and networking, and individual training and career development opportunities.

 At AIT, we create an inclusive and family-friendly working environment that promotes equal opportunities and actively strengthens diversity across our workforce and in leadership positions. Among other initiatives, we are committed to increasing the proportion of women in our company and therefore particularly welcome applications from female applicants.
